paragraphs: In the Jerusalem Talmud, Sotah chapter 4, halakhah 3: Rabbi Jacob bar Aha said: Akavya asked Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish; Rabbi Jeremiah [said]: Akavya asked Rabbi Hanina.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The bracketed [said] is already present in the supplied Hebrew. The two named recipients belong to alternative reported versions.

The full Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 4:3 paragraph reports Akavya’s question to Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish through Rabbi Yaakov bar Acha and to Rabbi Chanina through Rabbi Yirmiyah. It then asks whether there were two cases. The supplied bracketed [said] and the two reports are preserved; the comparison does not merge the cases or import a legal conclusion.
